title: Luxon
description: Modpack optimized for improving game performance. Boost FPS while maintaining stability and smoother gameplay.
body:
# ⚡ Luxon

Luxon is a professional, high-performance, minimalist client-side optimization suite for Minecraft Java Edition. Luxon improves frame rates, memory allocation, and game logic processing without altering core vanilla mechanics. 

Whether you are exploring massive single-player worlds or competing on multiplayer servers, Luxon provides technical stability and peak performance out of the box.

---

## 🚀 Key Features
* **Higher FPS**: Smooths out gameplay and reduces screen stuttering.
* **Faster Loading**: Chunks and worlds load quicker during exploration.
* **Lower Memory Usage**: Decreases the amount of RAM your game consumes.
* **Server Compatibility**: Works perfectly on all multiplayer servers and single-player worlds.
